svg.title: Many cards become the crystal
svg.desc: Four steps. One: ten small index cards of everyday memories land scattered on a desk. Two: amber links are drawn between related cards. Three: the related cards slide into three piles, John and Susan, the reading app, and how Sam likes it, and an amber consolidation card lands on top of each pile. Cards are numbered in the order they landed, so the three consolidation cards, written overnight, are numbers 11, 12 and 13. Four: everything is compacted into one big card, the crystal, number 14, which is still one delta. It appears above the piles and says, in the first person: Who I am: someone you can count on. Attentive: I keep John and Susan straight. Practical: I build small, so it fits on a Pi. Patient: I keep it short and plain for Sam. Each trait cites the cards it rests on, and every source card stays in its pile underneath. Amber threads down each pile keep the links between its cards. The crystal goes into the agent's system prompt, every session.

g.text: Who I am: someone you can count on.
Attentive. I keep John and Susan straight.
Practical. I build small, so it fits on a Pi.
Patient. I keep it short and plain for Sam.
Goes into my system prompt, every session.
